Choosing between HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Plus and ICICI Lombard Elevate is like comparing two high-end smartphones; both are excellent, but they serve slightly different priorities. 

Video Description

Are you confused between HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Plus and ICICI Lombard Elevate? Both plans are game-changers in the Indian health insurance market, offering "unlimited" features, but which one actually fits your family's needs? In this video, we dive deep into a side-by-side comparison to find the winner.

Key Highlights of the Comparison:

- The "Double" Power: How HDFC Ergo’s Secure Benefit doubles your cover from Day 1 compared to ICICI’s Power Booster.
- The Unlimited Game: We explain ICICI Lombard’s Infinite Care (unlimited claim amount) vs. HDFC Ergo’s Unlimited Restore.
- Room Rent: Who gives you more freedom? (HDFC Ergo allows any room category, while Elevate generally defaults to a Single Private Room).
- Chronic Care: A look at how both plans handle conditions like Diabetes and BP from Day 31.
- The "Plus" Factor: What makes the 'Plus' variant of Optima Secure different, including the Infinite Benefit (100% bonus every year with no cap).

Quick Comparison Table:

Feature | HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Plus | ICICI Lombard Elevate

Sum Insured | 10L to 2 Cr | 5L to Unlimited
Bonus | 100% every year (Infinite Benefit) | 20% to 100% (Power Booster)
Room Rent | No Limit (Any room) | Single Private Room
Consumables | Covered (Protect Benefit) | Optional Add-on
Global Cover | In-built (on higher SI) | Optional Add-on

Who should buy what?
- Choose HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Plus if: You want a plan where your cover grows every single year without a ceiling and you don't want any restrictions on hospital room types.
- Choose ICICI Lombard Elevate if: You are looking for a highly customizable plan with the option of an "Unlimited Sum Insured" and industry-first features like CIBIL-score based discounts.

Watch the full video to see the premium calculation and my final verdict!
